name: qabnah-web
description: Qabnah web apps: merchant portal + public storefront, admin panel, shared library and e2e tests

scripts.build: npm run build -w @qabnah/merchant && npm run build -w @qabnah/admin && npm run build -w @qabnah/site
scripts.test: npm run test -w @qabnah/shared && npm run test -w @qabnah/merchant
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @qabnah/shared && npm run typecheck -w @qabnah/merchant && npm run typecheck -w @qabnah/admin && npm run typecheck -w @qabnah/site && npm run typecheck -w @qabnah/e2e
